summary: HELGELANDS BLAD DRIFT AS (org. no. 987 699 655) is a private limited company (AS) based in Alstahaug, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2005-01-15. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 58.130 (Utgivelse av blader og tidsskrifter); it has 33 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 18.3 m and net income was NOK 930 925. CEO: Dag Ivar Forfang; board chair: Steinar Kristoffer Forfang; auditor: CEDRA NORGE AS.
